description: Manufacturing progress checkpoint emitted by the yoro-supply manufacture_track Pregel cell. One record per checkpoint milestone (raw-material-receipt / fabrication-start / qc-pass / packaging / factory-gate-ready). Carries factory telemetry photos IPFS-pinned (G2) and the QC firmware open-source attestation (G1). Per ADR-2605250850 + gates G1, G2.

checkpointPhase.description: Manufacturing phase reached. Records MUST be emitted in this order; a later phase implies all earlier phases passed.

telemetryPhotosIpfsCids.description: G2: IPFS CIDs of factory telemetry photos (provenance evidence). At least one per checkpoint.

qcResultIpfsCid.description: REQUIRED when checkpointPhase is `qc-pass`; IPFS CID of the QC test results document.

qcFirmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the QC testing equipment firmware manifest at this checkpoint.

quantityCompleted.description: Cumulative quantity completed at this checkpoint (units = parent purchaseOrder line's unitOfMeasure).

deviationFromScheduleHours.description: Signed delta from purchaseOrder.manufacturingScheduleIpfsCid (negative = ahead of schedule, positive = behind). Used by Gantt determinism check (G6).
